founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Founder & former CEO of XIX.ai, where I led the development of Entry—a sensorless biometric SSO with cutting-edge facial recognition and anti-spoofing. Raised $5M+ from Y Combinator (W17), Two Bear Capital, CabraVC, and top angel investors.  Previously a Staff Product Manager at Cribl, building Cribl Search, a federated search engine for machine data. Pilot, passionate about aviation and building new thing. Contributed to combating human trafficking, featured in Business Insider.
